entities.description: A custodial or legal account record. An account is not the same as the person or household associated with it.

fields.name: ACCT_NUM
fields.meaning: Source account identifier; preserve leading zeroes

relationship_rules: Do not assume account ownership or household membership from name similarity.
Use only documented source keys or an explicitly approved relationship mapping.

entities.description: A person, trust, or legal participant represented in the source identity domain.

fields.name: CLIENT_ID
fields.meaning: Source client identifier; preserve leading zeroes

fields.name: LEGAL_NAME
fields.meaning: Person or legal entity name as supplied by source

fields.name: TAX_ID
fields.meaning: Sensitive identifier; mask in previews and logs

relationship_rules: A client is distinct from an account and from a household.
Do not use TAX_ID as a join key unless explicitly authorized and governed.

entities.description: A business/reporting grouping of related clients and/or accounts. It is a grouping, not an individual legal identity.

fields.name: HH_ID
fields.meaning: Source household identifier; preserve leading zeroes

relationship_rules: Household membership must come from an explicit household mapping or documented source relationship.
Do not infer client-to-household or account-to-household joins from REP_CODE alone.
